settings.name: Cold-Pressed Castor Oil
settings.skin: Rich in essential fatty acids, it creates a protective moisture barrier that locks in hydration and guards the skin against environmental stressors.
settings.subtle: A deeply grounding anchor that provides a sense of safety and containment, helping you feel “at home” in your skin.

settings.name: Cold-Pressed Jojoba Oil
settings.skin: A superior moisturizing agent that mirrors the skin's natural sebum, allowing it to penetrate deeply to hydrate without clogging pores or leaving a greasy residue.
settings.subtle: Provides a stable, neutral foundation that allows your natural beauty and the intentional prayers of the elixir to shine through.

settings.name: Raw Frankincense Resin & Essential Oil
settings.skin: A powerful natural astringent that refines skin texture, tones the skin, and promotes a radiant, even-looking complexion.
settings.subtle: Known as the “King of Oils,” it acts as a bridge to the divine, clearing stagnant energy and anchoring the soul in presence.

settings.title: Cleansed
settings.body: Every single bottle is taken through a 3-part smoke process. First it is cleansed with white sage, followed by a blessing with palo santo and/or copal, and finished with the nourishment of sweet grass.

settings.title: Hand-crafted
settings.body: Every ingredient is cared for one-by-one by loving hands. Intentionally alchemized into being: honored, revered, prayed upon.

settings.title: Charged
settings.body: The finished oil rests on our altar for a minimum of 21 days, continually prayed upon with love: amethyst for protection, rose quartz for self-love, citrine for abundance and tiger's eye for confidence.

settings.label: Ingredients
settings.body:
Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil (certified organic), Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil (certified organic), Boswellia Carterii Resin Extract, and Frankincense Oil (Boswellia carterii, sacra, papyrifera, frereana). Nothing else.

Jojoba mirrors the skin's natural sebum, so it sinks in without clogging pores or leaving a greasy feel. Liquid Gold is non-comedogenic.

settings.label: How to use
settings.body:
Apply 2–3 drops to clean, slightly damp skin (face, hands or body), morning or night.

A little goes a long way: one 1 oz bottle typically lasts 6–8 weeks with daily use.

settings.label: Shipping
settings.lead: Shipped within the US by USPS.
settings.body:
Orders ship within 2–3 business days via USPS, and usually arrive 3–5 business days later. We currently ship within the United States only.

Unopened bottles can be returned within 30 days for a full refund, and anything that arrives damaged or defective is replaced at no cost.

settings.label: Sensitive skin
settings.body: As with any new skincare product, do a small patch test 24 hours before full use, and stop using it if irritation occurs. Liquid Gold is a cosmetic and has not been evaluated by the FDA.
